name: task-breakdown
description: Turns a goal, spec or messy brief you type or paste into a structured work plan: 3-6 phases named by outcome, small tasks with ids, relative sizes (S/M/L/XL), dependencies, 1-3 acceptance criteria and owner placeholders. Code computes the order of work, the parallel waves, the critical path in relative units, per-phase totals and lanes for a team of N. Also emits a downloadable task_plan.md. Revise it in the same chat (split T4, merge T2 and T3, add a security review phase, we are 2 people) and ask about it (critical path?, what depends on T5?) without re-planning. It never invents owners, dates or tools and creates nothing in a tracker: the plan is a draft. Not for writing the deliverable itself or general questions.

skills.name: Break a goal into a work plan
skills.description: Phases, sized tasks with dependencies and acceptance criteria, parallel waves, the critical path and team lanes computed in code, plus a task_plan.md file; revisable in the same chat.
examples: Break down building a customer feedback dashboard into tasks
